review.resultAssessment: Chivas did not win after the 1-1 entry, so the -0.5 handicap lost in full.
review.processAssessment: The official upgrade was too aggressive. It was issued only a few minutes after the equalizer, before 8-15 minutes of post-goal persistence had been established. The analysis relied on pre-equalizer and cumulative second-half dominance and treated momentum as continuing through the score reset. Under football v0.2.12, the goal required independent repricing with a fresh persistence penalty; the correct classification should have remained LEAN — WATCH or NO BET until post-goal pressure was reconfirmed. The user-reported heavy rain was an additional environmental factor that should have widened uncertainty if visible or known, but it does not excuse the persistence-gate failure.
review.executionAssessment: The accepted 1.96 price was only 0.03 below the quoted 1.99 and remained within the stated executable band. Price execution was acceptable. Stake execution was not compliant because 0.338u exceeded both the 0.25u recommendation and active football cap.
review.calibrationAction: After any equalizer or other score change, discard cumulative momentum as sufficient evidence for an official side. Require a fresh 8-15 minute post-goal trend or two synchronized post-goal snapshots before upgrading. Add an explicit pitch-and-weather condition check when heavy rain or a visibly waterlogged surface may alter tempo, passing, footing or finishing.
